visual.description: Full-viewport video background with centered headline text overlaid at vertical center, small playback controls bottom-left, sound toggle bottom-left, mascot badge bottom-right.
Sticky top bar with icon group (location, search) flush left, centered wordmark logo with 'PARIS' subtitle, single icon (account) flush right.
Secondary nav bar below main bar with 4 equally spaced uppercase text links centered across full width.
Three equal-width product cards on a light beige background, each with a centered product image above and centered small-caps title and subtitle text below.

Centered section heading above a 2-column layout with unequal sizing — left column narrower with a portrait product image and Instagram handle, right column wider with a square product image; images vertically offset creating asymmetric height.
Full-width section split into left text column (heading, subtitle, CTA link) and right image column occupying roughly 60% of width with a product photograph that bleeds to the right edge.
Wide image section with text overlaid at bottom-left in white uppercase letters, transitioning from previous section with visible cut.
Centered heading 'THE SEASONS OF GOYARD' above a 3-column equal-width grid of product images on a light beige background, with small-caps product names centered below each image.
White background section split into left column with centered heading, body text, and email input field with submit, and right column containing a product/editorial photograph.

Dark forest-green full-width carousel with a centered featured store image flanked by partially visible adjacent images, prev/next arrow controls on sides, store name and address centered below, and a text link 'ALL OUR BOUTIQUES' centered at bottom.

Forest-green footer with 4 equal-width columns of navigation links (Customer Service, Maison Goyard, Legal Information, Accessibility with toggle switches), centered monogram logo with brand wordmark and tagline below, a row of social media icon circles, and copyright line flush right.
